verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Pinecone acting as an MCP server that external agents (Claude, Cursor, Claude Code) connect to. Nothing shows Pinecone, including its Assistant product, acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers and use their tools. The server-side evidence is a different role and does not transfer to this story, and because Pinecone ships an AI assistant product, client-side MCP is a fair question, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
